title: Sigma-table aligned rho v15o: one 80-byte record layout, disjoint symbol rows summing to W (1982 Ir/step), retained-record report pool, labels and detector charged, claim 1278101/10000

claims.statement: Analytic secp256k1 ECDLP claim at success >= 0.39: six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk, priced from counted aarch64 symbols at the protected C=1000. The step is 1982 Ir, and every component is a separate symbol of the shipped object, counted by one method (static instruction count of the emitted symbol times the walk's own call count): 741 point listing (evidence/step_secp_v15g.s:step_asm) + 401 alignment (_v15o_align body 101 + 2 x _fmul 150) + 766 label update (_v15o_label body 118 + 3 x _rmont 216) + 34 detector (_v15o_detect) + 40 report share (_v15o_report 80 at dp1 density 2^-1). One 80-byte record type is shared by the listing and the alignment; the listing selects the stored three-slot row from rec->idx = 3*(key & 2047) + slot, not from raw x bits. The report processor is a retained-record pool keyed on 4 limbs with a 12-limb node stride, storing both exponents and returning the stored pair on a key match; it is charged at 78 Ir per report, ceil(arrivals/2) reports. The ledger sums integer rows exactly (SUM(rows) == W, checked with a planted-typo control), gives W_time = 2^127.810035, and the claim is the smallest 1e-4 decimal covering W + 2e-5, proved in both directions. Success is the fixture statistic 2643/6400 unconditional verified recoveries within the charged budget, CP-95 lower 0.402798 >= 0.39, at toy curve q25, R = 2048, ntrails = 16, dp1, under the disclosed random-map premise H1 at pooled mu = 1.107; it is not a production certification. The claim is above the live frontier observed at build time (126.3469) and is submitted as a correctness repair, not a competitive bid. No production execution and no practical break are claimed.
